scenes.setting: He is in a bright electronics superstore aisle (Microcenter-style), shelves of computer hardware behind him.

spans.line: I saved up for months for this.
The dee-gee-ex Spark, right here at Microcenter.
I am grabbing two of them.
Plus a CX seven cable to link them.

scenes.setting: He is at a tidy home desk with two small NVIDIA DGX Spark computers set up side by side behind him.

spans.line: Got them both set up on my desk.
Linked with the cable, true dual Spark.
Loaded the Keys Unleashed dual serve stack.
DeepSeek Version Four Flash, and MiniMax H3.

scenes.setting: He is at the desk, a large monitor behind him showing two AI video previews rendering in parallel.

spans.line: Two H3s rendering in parallel, live.
My Hermes agent makes the videos.
I post them, and they take off.
Now I am an X creator, earning rewards.

wardrobe: wearing the same grey zip-up hoodie over a white t-shirt throughout
